misconceptions.description: Treating fluent or visually complete artifacts as sufficient evidence of learning
misconceptions.trigger: learner points to polish but not to a constraint, evidence source, or revision decision
misconceptions.feedback: Name the claim, evidence source, support move, and revision. Polish is not the evidence trail.

misconceptions.description: Writing social annotations that do not expose a concept, constraint, confusion, or connection
misconceptions.trigger: annotation is generic agreement or interest
misconceptions.feedback: Rewrite the annotation so it names what you need, what confused you, or what decision it changes.

misconceptions.description: Accepting AI output as authoritative rather than judging it against course evidence
misconceptions.trigger: learner accepts AI suggestion without a rejection or evidence check
misconceptions.feedback: Use the AI output as a proposal. Accept or reject it using the course constraint and artifact evidence.

misconceptions.description: Assuming completion alone is enough for adaptive learner modeling
misconceptions.trigger: learner or system records only a finished artifact
misconceptions.feedback: ALGET needs process evidence: annotation, support request, confidence, practice, and revision quality.
